period_note: Filed by the bank as a '2nd Quarter' discrete filing. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2022. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2023 (H1 YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Apr-Jun 2023) figures, not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR quality is good. Extensively cross-validated: the H1-2022 comparative column matches 2022_Q2.json's own figures on every field EXCEPT one -- this filing's own H1-2022 'Net investment income' comparative reads -55,654,555, which disagrees with what was originally transcribed into 2022_Q2.json from that filing's own OCR (-35,654,555, a 2-vs-5 digit misread). Cross-checked via the income-sum identity (net investment income + income from shares + commission + other operating income must equal the already-agreed Total operating income (A) of 197,683,448 for H1-2022): only -55,654,555 closes it. 2022_Q2.json has been corrected accordingly (see its own metric_note). As in other quarters, the source's 'Total provision (D)' line is printed as a plain positive figure regardless of charge/release direction; the true sign (-20.0m, a net recovery) is derived as C minus the reported PBT. Income-statement chain closes exactly for H1-2023 (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.39, matching the filing's own Notes section).
